# Oxcart Mission Control (public, read-only snapshot)

Static, sanitised, one-way snapshot of an Oxcart development board and its GitHub issues.
Nothing here can execute commands, modify issues, or reach the development machine.

Structured data (JSON, UTF-8, always current to about 1-3 minutes while the dev machine is on):
- data/status.json : counts and `generated` timestamp (check freshness first; stale after 15 minutes)
- data/issues.json : GitHub issues {number, title, state, labels, updated, description, acceptance_criteria,
                     dependencies, assigned_agent, priority, status, progress_pct, progress_basis}
                     (sensitive items appear only as {number, state, withheld:true})
- data/state.json  : tasks (id, title, description, status, priority, progress_pct, progress_basis,
                     assigned_agent, branch, dependencies, acceptance_criteria, last_test, last_review, issue),
                     agents (status = declared by the agent, process_state Alive|Exited|Unknown from the OS process table, connection_state Connected|Stale|Disconnected inferred from heartbeat age, current_task, note, last_heartbeat, branch; a Disconnected agent may still be alive), recent events, approvals,
                     kanban columns
priority is "unspecified" unless an issue carries a priority:* label. progress_pct is an ESTIMATE derived from board status (Backlog 0, Assigned 5, In Progress 40, Review 80, Ready to Merge 95, Done 100; parents average their stage tasks); it is not a measurement. agents[].last_heartbeat is floored to 5 minutes.

Task statuses: Backlog, Assigned, In Progress, Review, Ready to Merge, Done, Blocked.
Published from an explicit field allowlist. Not published: local paths, e-mail addresses, credentials, commit subjects, file lists, message/heartbeat/handoff text, full issue bodies, internal discussions.
